## 0.2.1 (2026-11-03)

### 🚀 Features

- **planner-llm:** use the catalog's default variant for new instances when the request omits a variant ([#361](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/361)). Explicit variant requests take precedence. This default does not select an ambiguous target or change an existing instance's variant.

### 🩹 Fixes

- **devtools-mcp-server:** report the installed package version during MCP initialization, including in bundled applications ([#397](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/397), [#374](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/issues/374)).
